slots.name: tab
slots.notes: tool context, shown as caps on the brick tab

slots.name: prompt
slots.notes: what the guest typed; data-at = when it lands

slots.name: reply
slots.notes: sentence spans each with data-at; one <em> = the phrase that gets the gold highlighter band (keep it under ~30 chars)

summary: Cream AI chat snippet pops beside the host on the right (.9 to 1, 2% settle), prompt then reply land on the words, one phrase gets a gold highlighter band.

slots.name: msg-in
slots.notes: incoming bubble, data-at on its row

slots.name: msg-out
slots.notes: AI-drafted reply; dashed draft, fills brick on send (send button data-at); one <em> flips to gold

slots.name: note
slots.notes: system row, e.g. a booking confirmation

summary: Flat deep phone docked right of the speaker for a whole demo; a messages app where an AI-drafted reminder is sent, bubbles arriving on data-at; orange send button.

slots.name: screen-lines
slots.notes: short lines of the AI reply on the small dimmed screen, ~40 chars each

slots.name: line-1
slots.notes: the one magnified line at 44px; one <em> = gold word on a deep sliver

slots.name: line-2
slots.notes: optional; hard-swaps in at its data-at

summary: Small cream chat screen dims as a cream lens pops over its lower-left edge, lifting one AI line at 44px with the key word gold; second line is a hard swap.

slots.name: lines
slots.notes: 5 to 7 lines, max ~44 chars each (nowrap). Mark one li class="key" with data-at (gold band) and up to two li class="sup" (cream 18% bands, .15s apart, optional data-at)

summary: Brick prompt card on the right; a gold band wipes behind the one key line and its ink flips to deep, two supporting lines get cream-18% bands.

slots.name: action
slots.notes: button label; button data-at = the click

summary: Cream confirm panel lower right; cursor glides to the orange button, 1-frame press, label swaps to a checked done state and a small count lands gold. Built to be cut away.
